paragraphs: Avimi bar Abbahu (see there). Avodah Zarah 34b; Shevuot 42a; Sanhedrin 99a. Rabbi Abbahu said, “Someone such as my son Avimi fulfilled the commandment of honoring.” Although he had five ordained sons, when Rabbi Abbahu called at the door he would run to open it and not let one of his sons go (Kiddushin 31b). He sent through Chama bar Rabbah bar Abbahu (Ketubbot 85a). Kiddushin 19a: Abaye, son of Rabbi Abbahu; perhaps a scribal error for Avimi.
